mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and accelerating inflation (year-over-year CPI growth above 2.5%) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND (CPIAUCSL / CPIAUCSL_prev12mo - 1) > 0.025 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weak labor market that may prompt monetary policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 800 (thousands of units), it signals strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 800 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 140000) signals an economic decoupling that may lead to inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 AND PAYEMS > 140000 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 400000 (millions of dollars), it signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).
